query:
UPDATE delegations
             SET level = COALESCE($3, level),
                 all_accounts = COALESCE($4, all_accounts),
                 expires_at = CASE WHEN $5 THEN $6 ELSE expires_at END,
                 updated_at = now(), updated_by = $7
             WHERE owner_id = $1 AND id = $2 AND ended_at IS NULL
